title: Mixed cash/electronic checkout cannot confirm its electronic leg
blueprint_summary: Key journal entries by stable leg identity, e.g. 'sale-{CheckoutRequestId}-{TenderType}'. Transition pending electronic leg atomically to confirmed.

title: Cancelling pending mixed electronic payment hides collected cash without reversal
blueprint_summary: When cancelling a mixed tender order, check if any cash leg was deposited and atomically post a reversal journal movement to the drawer.

title: Refund can debit money for an order that was never collected
blueprint_summary: Enforce invariant in Order.ApplyRefund that order must be fully collected (IsPaid == true) and refund amount cannot exceed collected tender.

title: Concurrent distinct invoice settlements can overpay supplier and corrupt invoice cache
blueprint_summary: Execute invoice settlement within an explicit Serializable transaction or apply pessimistic locking (UPDLOCK, ROWLOCK) on the purchasing invoice record.

title: Unvalidated signed delivery fee can bypass intended discount and comp authorization
blueprint_summary: Validate delivery fee server-side against configured delivery rates or require manager override for non-standard delivery fees.

title: Split Payment Electronic Split Ceiling Restriction
blueprint_summary: Refactor Order and CheckoutPlan to support IReadOnlyList<ElectronicPayment> or enforce single-electronic split limit during checkout preflight.

title: JSON actor casing mismatch permits body-selected authorization identity
blueprint_summary: 1. In AuthenticationMiddleware.cs, parse request body using case-insensitive property name matching (e.g. EnumerateObject() with StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase). 2. Refactor Program.cs endpoint and UpdateUserPermissionsHandler to eliminate ActorUserId from wire DTOs and bind authorized caller identity exclusively from context.ActorId() established by token session resolution.

title: Shift Close Identity Spoofing via Unchecked ClosedByUserId
blueprint_summary: Add 'closedByUserId' to ActorFields in AuthenticationMiddleware.cs, or inject HttpContext.ActorId() directly in Minimal API endpoint binding.

title: Session Token Replacement & Identity Confusion in PIN Replay Proof
blueprint_summary: Implement dedicated POST /api/auth/verify-pin endpoint that validates PIN without issuing or mutating session tokens.

title: Historical cash refund omitted from current-shift expected cash
blueprint_summary: Compute drawer flow from posted operational cash movements or join refund rows by OperationalShiftId; avoid double deduction for same-shift refunds and preserve immutable closed shift snapshots. Separate original sale period from refund execution period.

title: Generic payroll transition marks run Paid without paying treasury or employee ledger
blueprint_summary: Disallow transition to Paid via generic TransitionPayrollHandler. Require execution exclusively through PayPayrollHandler which generates atomic treasury and ledger entries.

title: Restore pending-journal check does not exclude active or newly accepted financial work
blueprint_summary: Use a database-backed maintenance admission lease respected by all mutating handlers and background workers; drain in-flight operations, pause workers, take safety backup, restore and verify, clear stale pools/caches/sessions as designed, then resume only after durable outcome recording.

title: Shift opening and purchase receipt check protected account balance before their transactions
blueprint_summary: Start transaction before protected account balance load/check and hold lock through float/receipt writes; establish consistent account/shift/invoice lock order; make retries safe and preserve real concurrency errors.

title: Attendance correction credits do not enter calculated payroll
blueprint_summary: Reconcile both credit and debit sides of Adjustment into payroll net; preserve correction attribution and original earning basis if required; keep payroll freeze semantics explicit.

title: Restore success followed by MULTI_USER failure is classified as database not replaced
blueprint_summary: Track restore replacement separately from recovery/availability state; persist explicit replaced-but-recovery-incomplete outcome outside replaced database. Resolve uncertain SQL acknowledgments through a recovery protocol; do not auto-retry destructive restore.

title: Checkout can commit after its previously open shift has completed handover
blueprint_summary: Serialize checkout admission and shift close with a shared transaction-held Shift row protocol: lock/revalidate Open before writes, hold through commit; alternatively use a documented Closing/drain process. Preserve closed snapshots.

title: Pending mixed delivery includes already collected payment leg in driver custody
blueprint_summary: Use per-tender-leg collection status/amount when deriving driver custody. Do not reinterpret pending electronic receivable as driver cash; block dispatch or provide an explicit owner-approved conversion/recovery workflow.

title: Payroll Advance Calculation Ledger Entry Type Case Mismatch Causes Zero Advance Deductions
blueprint_summary: Update PayrollRules.OutstandingAdvance to check string equality using StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase or match against nameof(LedgerEntryType.Advance) / nameof(LedgerEntryType.PayrollSettlement).

title: BusinessClock DST Spring-Forward Transition Causes ArgumentException on Business Date Boundary Calculation
blueprint_summary: Before calling ConvertTimeToUtc, check CairoTimeZone.IsInvalidTime(localMidnight). If true, adjust forward by the DST gap (e.g. 1 hour to 01:00:00) or calculate the UTC instant using TimeZoneInfo.GetUtcOffset with gap tolerance.

title: Payroll Advance Deduction Missing from Employee Ledger Posting and Ledger Schema
blueprint_summary: Add an AdvanceDeductionPiastres column to EmployeeLedgerEntryEntity and update PayPayrollHandler to record the advance deduction amount on the posted settlement entry or post a distinct advance recovery entry.

title: Previously admitted treasury deposit can post after authoritative business-day close
blueprint_summary: Confirm whether financial writes are forbidden after close. If yes, coordinate day admission in the database: acquire a transaction-held lock/revision on the business-day row and revalidate Open within each financial write transaction; close takes the same lock before blocker evaluation/snapshot and waits for already-admitted writes. Define cross-process semantics, retry policy, and consistent lock order. If late postings are allowed, define how frozen snapshot reconciliation and subsequent deltas are represented instead of silently treating snapshot as current ledger.

title: Standalone employee settlements remain payable through frozen period payroll
blueprint_summary: Owner decision first. If settlements prepay same-period earnings, derive remaining liability from an explicit period/earning obligation and apply settlements both before payroll calculation and after run freeze; if the two paths are mutually exclusive, enforce atomic exclusion on both. Preserve frozen-run, replay, audit, source-balance, and historical-record behavior.

title: Concurrent pay/cancel can overwrite payroll terminal status
blueprint_summary: Use one database-coordinated PayrollRun state transition primitive for pay/cancel (transaction-held run-row lock or optimistic concurrency token/conditional Approved-to-claimed update). Payment must acquire/claim Approved within its transaction before movement/ledger posting; cancellation must perform mutually exclusive conditional transition. A losing operation must produce no movement, journal, settlement, paid-line, or status side effects. Preserve idempotency, filtered live-period index, and consistent treasury/run lock ordering.

title: Requested two-stage pickup preparation and final payment lifecycle is absent
blueprint_summary: Design separate pickup fulfilment state and payment state with server-authoritative transitions (two-stage reserve-and-prep -> pay-and-handover).

title: In-Memory Full Table Pull on StockMovements in ListInventoryItemsAsync
blueprint_summary: Perform GROUP BY and conditional SUM at the database level via EF Core / SQL query.

title: Inventory Deduction / Order Refund Restock Synchronization Gap
blueprint_summary: Introduce restock movement option in RefundOrderHandler to credit inventory upon refund of sellable items.

title: Two machines can submit the same pending kitchen job
blueprint_summary: Add composite unique index on (OrderId, Route, DocumentKind) in PrintJobEntity configuration, or ensure idempotent deduplication at database level.

title: Printer verification tool can delete preexisting restaurant tickets
blueprint_summary: Use dedicated test queue and exact returned job ID, verify pause state, never delete by document name; keep all live printer operations gated.

title: PIN-bearing user-management requests are durably stored as unencrypted JSON
blueprint_summary: Encrypt retained request payloads using Windows Data Protection API (ProtectedData.Protect with CurrentUser scope) prior to file write. Mask or redact PIN properties from retained request diagnostic envelopes.

title: Authenticated employee reads expose complete sensitive profiles without employee permission or self-access restriction
blueprint_summary: Introduce PublicEmployeeSummaryDto for operational cashier selection. Restrict GET /api/employees full profile to callers possessing 'employees_manage' or 'payroll_view' permissions.

title: Manager Approval Tokens Lack Expiration (TTL) Check
blueprint_summary: Pass DateTimeOffset nowUtc into AuthorizationPolicy.ValidateApproval and reject approvals older than a configurable TTL (e.g., 15 minutes).

title: PIN Uniqueness Check-Then-Act Race Condition
blueprint_summary: Wrap user creation and PIN modification inside a transaction with serializable isolation or table lock, or maintain a deterministic blind-index hash.

title: User Reactivation Missing PIN Uniqueness Verification
blueprint_summary: In SetUserActiveHandler, if request.Active is true, verify PIN uniqueness or require PIN reset upon reactivation.

title: Primary cashier and treasury money requests lose original retry identity on process loss
blueprint_summary: Persist exact versioned typed financial request and owner before dispatch; expose recovery by original identity, block replacement until outcome known; no fixes performed.

title: Requested pickup kitchen-before-payment stage is absent from active client workflow
blueprint_summary: Design explicit persisted pickup preparation/payment lifecycle using existing backend/domain capabilities where possible; implementation requires separate authorization.

title: Recovered electronic confirmation/cancellation has no reachable cashier retry context
blueprint_summary: Recover operation order context from persisted request or present a standalone pending-action recovery panel independent of transient checkout result.

title: Late CallCenter customer lookup can overwrite a different phone/new order
blueprint_summary: Snapshot normalized phone and monotonic form generation; discard stale responses/cancel on change/reset; clear incompatible resolved fields safely.

title: CallCenter customer-copy reprint requests kitchen preparation routes again
blueprint_summary: Send false for customer-only reprint; expose explicit separately confirmed kitchen reprint only if requirement exists.

title: Successful restore is reported incomplete because UI expects Completed instead of Succeeded
blueprint_summary: Use shared enum/contract success vocabulary and avoid treating generic HTTP success as outcome proof; maintain strict restore controls.

title: Management shift actions abandon unknown outcomes and generate a new request identity per retry
blueprint_summary: Share durable operation coordination between both shift presentations and register global pending before dispatch.

title: Recovered payroll transition or payment cannot reach its retry command
blueprint_summary: Recover run/visible action from stored request or expose generic pending-action verification independent of transient selection.

title: Late recipe-detail response can replace another recipe selection before editing
blueprint_summary: Use monotonic detail generation and validate again after every await; freeze target identity across edit/save.

title: PIN-change retry proof replaces shared bearer despite preserving visible user identity
blueprint_summary: Use isolated non-session-mutating proof client/endpoint and explicit owner context; coordinate with security report to avoid duplicate final finding.

title: Late product-image completion changes save target beneath another product form
blueprint_summary: Keep immutable operation target independent from current editor; only update visible state when selection generation still matches. Coordinate browse/save with image busy and invalidate late completions on close/kind/new.

title: Backup filenames collide within a second and WITH FORMAT can overwrite prior backup
blueprint_summary: Use collision-resistant immutable backup identity and exclusive create/no-overwrite destination semantics; preserve record-to-file identity. Retention should validate distinct canonical paths and never delete a file still referenced by a retained record.

title: Concurrent different open-day requests create multiple active business days
blueprint_summary: Represent single active ownership with a database-enforced singleton/unique active-state key acquired transactionally by open and reopen. Reconcile existing duplicate active rows explicitly before constraint migration; make read gate fail closed if invariant is corrupt.

title: Collected sales report drops immediate money from pending mixed payments
blueprint_summary: Compute pending collection as the pending leg amount(s) and separately report gross/net sale recognition from tender settlement timing. Do not infer collection solely from order IsPaid or subtract whole order for partial pending tender.

title: Owner dashboard adds outgoing stock instead of subtracting it
blueprint_summary: Apply proper sign negation: (m.Direction == StockMovementDirection.Out ? -m.QuantityMilliUnits : m.QuantityMilliUnits).

title: Financial approval provenance can retain unvalidated shift presenter or discard verified driver variance approver
blueprint_summary: Carry verified gate result, actor, and actual approver identity separately to all financial rows/audit; preserve OR authorization policy and approval reason semantics.

title: Negative receipt quantity and unit cost can post stock reduction with supplier debt
blueprint_summary: Validate direction-specific positive receipt quantities and nonnegative costs before posting. If returns are required, implement a separate explicit return/credit-note flow rather than encoding them as receipt negatives.

title: First stock receipt can race unit-change admission and reinterpret movement history
blueprint_summary: Coordinate unit edits and first movement admission through a shared DB transaction lock/revision invariant used by both edit and every movement writer. Version only works if both paths participate.

title: Accepted numeric Inclusive tax mode is persisted raw and consumed as Exclusive
blueprint_summary: Persist parsed TaxMode canonical enum value, reject undefined/unsupported forms, and make consumers use canonical parsed mode. Keep historical order tax snapshots frozen.

title: Accepted case-insensitive compensation type is stored raw but wage/payroll consumers require canonical names
blueprint_summary: Persist parsed CompensationType canonical value and use parsed enum in attendance/payroll consumers; validate defined supported types at API boundary.

title: Attendance checkout reconstructs check-in on checkout UTC date and can omit overtime
blueprint_summary: Retain full check-in date/time and compute elapsed interval from that persisted event under documented timezone and repeated-punch policy; do not reconstruct from checkout date.

title: Manual daily-wage and overtime commands admit negative earning credits
blueprint_summary: Reject negative command-specific wage/rate and overflow before posting; define zero policy. Do not globally ban signed Money or clamp negative earnings into zero.

title: Manual ledger accepts undefined numeric types excluded from named financial categories
blueprint_summary: Require Enum.IsDefined plus an explicit supported-type/credit-debit policy before manual ledger posting; preserve valid named types and classify legacy unsupported values explicitly.

title: Distinct employee credit requests can persist and display stale running-balance snapshots
blueprint_summary: Either serialize all ledger appends on one employee anchor with consistent lock order, or compute statement running balance from ordered immutable facts and retire stale BalanceAfter as authority. Define deterministic timestamp tie-breaker.

title: Frozen business-day financial snapshots omit the corresponding live-report permission gate
blueprint_summary: Apply reports_view to latest/history financial snapshot reads using verified authenticated actor; if broader archive access is intended, define a distinct explicit permission rather than reusing control-center permission.

title: Spent manager approval prevents acknowledgement replay of committed overtime and extra-shift credits
blueprint_summary: After validating actor/session and binding the durable request to target and payload, resolve an existing committed receipt before consuming approval again. Keep fresh-operation approval and atomic persistence.

title: Owner dashboard stock projection ignores outbound movement direction
blueprint_summary: Use shared direction-aware stock balance projection or apply Direction sign in dashboard query; keep inventory overview as parity oracle.

title: Arithmetic Overflow Exception in Money.Abs() on long.MinValue
blueprint_summary: Add guard in Money.Abs(): if (Piastres == long.MinValue) throw new DomainException("Cannot compute absolute value of minimum long piastres"); or clamp safely.

title: Unvalidated Negative Delivery Service Fee Allows Artificially Reduced Order Payable Total
blueprint_summary: Add validation in CreateDeliveryServiceHandler, UpdateDeliveryServiceHandler, and DeliveryServiceRequests validating FeePiastres >= 0; add domain assertion in CheckoutRules asserting deliveryFee.IsPositive || deliveryFee.IsZero.

title: BusinessDayCloseEvaluator Performs Global Unbounded Table Scans Blocking Business Day Close on Historical Data
blueprint_summary: Add WHERE predicates restricting shifts and driver custodies to the specific business day being closed (e.g. s.BusinessDate == day.BusinessDate or s.BusinessDayId == day.Id), and scope journal checks to the relevant window.

title: PurchasingQueryService Performs Unbounded Full Table Scan on Supplier Ledger Entries in ListSuppliersAsync
blueprint_summary: Replace the full-table memory load with an EF Core query that groups by SupplierId and aggregates Debit and Credit sums directly in SQL Server.

title: Multi-Payment Order Refund Inability in Cashier UI and Backend Domain Exception on Treasury Allocation
blueprint_summary: Obtain restaurant owner business decision on multi-payment refund settlement rules (e.g., refund to cash drawer vs original tender pro-rata). Update UI to allow refund initiation and extend RefundOrderHandler and TreasuryMovementFactory to allocate multi-payment refund legs.

title: Distinct concurrent business-day opens can pass pre-insert active-state validation
blueprint_summary: Confirm the invariant scope. If one active BusinessDay is intended, enforce it at the same persistence boundary as the single-open-shift invariant (provider-appropriate active-row uniqueness or a serialized admission row/lock covering Open and Reopen), and make losing admission return a stable conflict without partial side effects. Preserve same-request idempotency. Do not rely solely on a pre-insert read.

title: Call Center labels a cancelled unpaid electronic order as collectible on delivery
blueprint_summary: Make payment text state-aware: cancelled orders should show cancelled/no collection, pending transfers stay unconfirmed, settled orders stay paid, and collect-on-delivery is reserved for active unpaid orders that satisfy COD semantics. Confirm the preferred Arabic copy with owner if wording is material.

title: Unvalidated denomination and unchecked arithmetic can corrupt finalized count values
blueprint_summary: Owner must first decide whether ExpectedPiastres is a client-supplied comparison target or must be derived from a server-authoritative snapshot. Then whitelist supported positive denominations and bound each quantity/aggregate; use checked multiply, sum, and difference and convert overflow/invalid rows to explicit domain rejection. Preserve agreed negative-quantity compatibility semantics or reject only by explicit policy.

title: Close snapshot revision and authoritative-row admission lack an explicit shared invariant
blueprint_summary: Do not implement a concurrency fix based on assumed SQL ordering. First test provider schedule; if admission gap manifests, use common day lock/state predicate plus explicit snapshot uniqueness/authority invariant.

title: Attendance corrections revalue old effects at current rates instead of posted monetary basis
blueprint_summary: After owner decision, calculate correction delta against actual posted original facts and cumulative linked adjustments, append only; preserve idempotency, locks, and freeze rules. Do not mint historical credits automatically.

title: Delivery report field labeled expected unsettled custody aggregates collected amount instead
blueprint_summary: Confirm report contract. Existing DTO name, owner dashboard, and test comments support ExpectedPiastres: if that is the intended meaning, sum c.ExpectedPiastres. If the intended metric is collected-but-unsettled, rename the DTO/display and retain/add a distinct expected-at-risk metric so the two values are not conflated.

title: Server accepts a negative product-variant price that can reduce checkout totals while stock is consumed
blueprint_summary: Confirm whether zero-priced variants are allowed. If prices must be positive, centralize the invariant at server command boundaries and checkout resolution, and evaluate a DB check constraint after legacy-row inventory. Preserve signed Money for legitimate ledger deltas.

title: Unknown once-per-order packaging cost does not invalidate aggregate profit completeness
blueprint_summary: Carry an explicit aggregate cost-coverage/completeness signal across dish and order-packaging components into profitability calculation and DTO, preserving distinct dish counts and per-order packaging cardinality. Keep missing names. Do not convert packaging unknowns into fabricated sold dish-line counts.

title: Concurrent opposite prep edges can evade pretransaction cycle admission
blueprint_summary: Coordinate graph mutations with a transaction-scoped shared graph revision/lock, then revalidate against the current graph before persisting. Alternatively use serializable predicate validation with bounded retry and consistent cross-process semantics. Retain defensive Unknown cycle guard for existing/legacy data.

title: Overlapping full-refund replay can reject after same-key sibling committed
blueprint_summary: Recheck same-key durable refund receipt after acquiring order lock and before cap rejection; preserve actor/order/payload binding, cap and funds rules. Do not broadly treat DomainException as replay.

title: Reversed report endpoints normalize sales but independently filter cost with contradictory date bounds
blueprint_summary: Normalize or reject reversed date endpoints once at shared request boundary and pass one interval to sales, cost, expenses, and date-series calculations.

title: SafeDrop may attribute a later drawer movement to a closed shift and change its reprinted breakdown
blueprint_summary: If prohibit: enforce shift-open state in a concurrency-safe transaction boundary shared with shift close. If allow: represent later movement as an explicit post-close adjustment/revision and distinguish it from the immutable close snapshot in reprints.

title: Legacy WPF refund submit does not preserve the same idempotency key after an ambiguous outcome
blueprint_summary: If WPF is supported, route refund commands through explicit unknown-outcome state and retain/reconcile the same request ID before allowing a new submit. If WPF is retired, record that operational fact. Decide whether WinUI unresolved refund intent must survive restart; if so, persist a safe pending key or require authoritative refund lookup before another command. Preserve server amount and account guards.

title: Held electronic preparation is not automatically released on confirmation
blueprint_summary: Explicitly communicate manual release now; future approved implementation should persist held state and transactionally enqueue release with stable key on confirmation.

title: Uncosted Waste Coercion to Zero in Loss Summary
blueprint_summary: Expose UnknownCostCount in LossSummaryDto to inform managers when loss values are incomplete.

title: CostingRules Yield Unit Conversion Uses Midpoint Banker's Rounding Causing Asymmetric Stock Deduction Truncation
blueprint_summary: Compute total deducted base milliUnits across the entire ordered quantity using integer division with rounding: (line.QuantityMilliUnits * orderQuantity + ratio / 2) / ratio, or specify explicit MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero.

title: Succeeded and print health collapse transport acceptance into physical completion
blueprint_summary: Use distinct Simulated, Submitted, SpoolerQueued, Failed, OutcomeUnknown and PhysicallyConfirmed observations. Never drain real pending jobs to file as production completion.

title: Blocking spooler submission ignores cancellation and completion failures
blueprint_summary: Check finalization results, retain submission job ID, move blocking native submission to a controlled worker with bounded shutdown/uncertain outcome semantics.

title: Agent never authenticates again after session loss
blueprint_summary: Add controlled reauthentication and explicit offline/authentication alarm without losing attempt journal or blindly resending uncertain jobs.

title: Saved printer width and receipt copy count do not control inspected print pipeline
blueprint_summary: Define per-station paper capability and copy semantics; explicitly label unsupported settings until implemented. Copies must not multiply kitchen prep accidentally.

title: Unguarded Read Access to Payroll Runs, Backups, Treasury, and Purchases
blueprint_summary: Apply RequirePermission(context, permission) filters to all sensitive read endpoints in Program.cs.

title: Approval Double-Spending Concurrency Hazard (CHALLENGED WITH COUNTEREVIDENCE)
blueprint_summary: Retain concurrency token in FalahDbContext, and catch DbUpdateConcurrencyException in command handlers to translate to DomainException('اعتماد المدير مستخدم بالفعل').

title: High PBKDF2 Computational Cost on PIN Uniqueness Validation
blueprint_summary: Use deterministic HMAC blind indexing with a server pepper for O(1) uniqueness lookup, reserving PBKDF2 only for credential storage.

title: User Deactivation Omits Explicit Session Token Revocation
blueprint_summary: In SetUserActiveHandler, mark all active sessions for the user as revoked (RevokedAtUtc = now).

title: Unselected expense and payment buttons combine literal white with dark-theme pale text
blueprint_summary: Use coherent semantic card/neutral background with themed primary text for unselected state, direct ThemeResource/visual states for live updates; selected accent uses suitable contrast foreground.

title: Imperative/converter brush results do not track live per-window theme reliably
blueprint_summary: Prefer theme-bound visual states/resources; explicitly observe ActualThemeChanged and traverse actual dictionary topology if imperative lookup retained.

title: A new pickup inherits previous order optional collection schedule
blueprint_summary: Reset optional schedule with resolved new-order lifecycle and explicit cart cancellation; keep historic order review separate.

title: Printer status UI exposes only four of six implemented routes
blueprint_summary: Derive displayed route options from complete shared contract plus localized labels.

title: Workspace shortcut guard omits most open operational modals
blueprint_summary: Centralize IsAnyModalOpen plus accessible focus isolation and apply to all shortcuts.

title: Discarded definitively rejected CallCenter reprint survives in journal
blueprint_summary: Clear disk atomically when explicitly discarding known-rejected print; preserve unknown state separately.

title: Legacy WPF change display parses EGP tender as integer piastres
blueprint_summary: If WPF remains supported, use same tested CashInput units and notifications; otherwise prevent accidental deployment.

title: CallCenter lock/unlock retains old order-panel visual trees through cart subscription
blueprint_summary: Track subscribed VM, detach on change/unload, reattach once Loaded.

title: Recipe yield conversion silently truncates fractional pieces-per-base-unit
blueprint_summary: Validate integer divisibility before division or use dedicated localized positive-integer parser.

title: Recipe ingredient picker truncates to60 choices without exposing its search input
blueprint_summary: Bind explicit ingredient search to IngredientSearchText or provide searchable full-list picker; disclose bounds only as presentation optimization.

title: EmployeesViewModel Sequentially Executes N+1 API Calls for Balances and Exits Early on First Failure Leaving Employee List Empty
blueprint_summary: Introduce a bulk employee balance endpoint on the server, or fetch balances concurrently with Task.WhenAll and gracefully degrade individual failed balances while still displaying successfully loaded employees.
